content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete stack of tools that let you sell digital assets without relying on third-party platforms. It’s not a workaround or a plugin. It’s base-layer architecture: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment verification. You own every component. When a buyer pays in crypto, the system automatically verifies the transaction on-chain, delivers the asset, and logs the order—all without you touching anything. This matters because it removes geographic and financial barriers. In Kenya, where traditional payment processors are restricted, this stack lets you collect revenue in 300+ cryptocurrencies. The buyer pays in their preferred coin. The system converts it to USD at transaction time. You get paid. No platform takes a cut. No buyer friction. Full ownership.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle payment verification and file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Assets are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. When a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. The webhook triggers the backend logic, which delivers the asset and logs the order. The buyer gets instant access. You get paid. The system is stateless—no databases to manage, no servers to maintain. It’s designed to scale without recurring costs. You deploy it once. It runs forever.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this stack gives you a global marketplace. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. Who want to collect payment in any cryptocurrency, not just USD. Who want to deliver assets automatically, without manual intervention. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe—where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. If it works there, it works anywhere. This isn’t a solution for victims. It’s for creators who chose better architecture. Who chose sovereignty over dependency.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes geographic and financial barriers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic—payment verification, order logging, and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 store your assets. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with 0.5% fees, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is open and interoperable. You deploy the stack in 48 hours. You own it forever. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. The system is modular—you can swap components as needed. It’s designed to evolve with your business, not lock you in.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant download. Deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02 in 48 hours. Load your products. Test end-to-end. Go live. The kit includes NOWPayments integration guides, scaling playbooks, and 30-day support. If you prefer to build from scratch, start with GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. Use NOWPayments for crypto payments. Test each component individually, then integrate. The key is to deploy incrementally. Start small. Scale as revenue grows. The goal is sovereignty—not just revenue, but ownership of the infrastructure that generates it.

It uses free hosting (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase, Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive, Cloudflare R2), and crypto payments (NOWPayments). The buyer pays in any cryptocurrency. The system converts it to USD at transaction time. You get paid. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership.

It’s the fastest way to launch a sovereign commerce stack without building from scratch. The kit includes NOWPayments integration guides, scaling playbooks, and 30-day support. Start with Stack 01 or Stack 02. Load your products. Test end-to-end. Go live.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload assets: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate crypto payments: NOWPayments with automatic webhooks. 6. Test end-to-end: Simulate a purchase. Verify asset delivery. 7. Deploy live: Publish your storefront. 8. Monitor transactions: Track payments and orders in real-time. 9. Scale incrementally: Add more products. Optimize performance. 10. Own your stack: No platform dependencies. No recurring fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can buyers pay with any cryptocurrency?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. The buyer pays in their preferred coin. The system converts it to USD at transaction time. You get paid in stable value.
Do buyers need to create an account?
No. The system is accountless. Buyers pay directly from their crypto wallets. No KYC. No sign-ups. Frictionless purchases.
What happens if a payment fails?
The system verifies payments on-chain. If a payment fails, the asset is not delivered. The buyer must retry. You’re protected from invalid transactions.
Can I use this in Kenya?
Yes. This stack is designed for regions where Stripe and PayPal are restricted. It works in Kenya, Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and anywhere else traditional platforms are unavailable.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this?
Basic technical skills are required. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints to simplify deployment. If you can follow instructions, you can deploy this stack.
